entry.name: AI Engineering in Python
entry.note: A project-based learning path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Career changers who want to learn by building projects

covers: Python programming and tooling for AI workflows
LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and tool use
Building and deploying AI applications with FastAPI and Docker
Data analysis and visualization with pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning with scikit-learn
Embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search
reading.format: Hands-on guided projects with code written and feedback received directly in the browser, building a portfolio of real AI applications.
reading.summary: This path takes learners from Python fundamentals to deploying production AI systems. It covers working with large language models through APIs and prompt engineering, then builds data analysis and machine learning skills before moving into embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation architectures. Learners complete hands-on guided projects and finish with a portfolio of real AI applications.
reading.audience: People starting from zero who want to become job-ready AI engineers in about 10 months.
